title: Government Hikes Import Duty on Gold & Silver to 15% to Protect Forex Reserves
summary: GoI increases customs duty on gold and silver from 6% to 15% (10% BCD + 5% AIDC) amid West Asia conflict and widening CAD.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 Government Hikes Import Duty on Gold & Silver to 15% to Protect Forex Reserves. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Government raised customs duty on gold and silver imports from 6% to **15% (10% BCD + 5% AIDC)** and platinum to 15.4%, reversing Budget 2024 cuts after gold imports surged 24% to $71.98 billion in FY26.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on CAD as % of GDP (1.3%), merchandise trade deficit figures, and invisibles/remittances surplus trajectory.
